brief:
Gadi Eisenkot, the former Israeli military chief, has positioned himself as a political alternative to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, according to Al Jazeera English. Eisenkot presents an unpolished, understated demeanor that stands in sharp contrast to Netanyahu's approach, signaling a different political direction.

However, analysts caution that Eisenkot risks continuing key aspects of Netanyahu's legacy despite their stylistic differences. The extent to which an Eisenkot-led government would chart a fundamentally different course remains uncertain.
dek: Unpolished and understated, Eisenkot offers a stark contrast to Netanyahu but risks continuing his legacy…
title: Eisenkot emerges as Netanyahu alternative with contrasting style
